findings.statement: Within the reported 2 M LiFSI/FDEE lithium-metal system, the supplied evidence supports a coherent chain in which the concentrated fluorinated electrolyte favors an anion-rich solvation structure, that structure promotes a LiF-rich interphase with suppressed parasitic reactions, and the resulting interphase state is associated with 99.5% lithium plating/stripping Coulombic efficiency at 1 mA cm−2 and 1 mAh cm−2.
findings.scope_boundary: This finding is limited to the reported 2 M LiFSI/FDEE lithium-metal chemistry and the stated plating/stripping test condition; it does not establish equivalent behavior in other electrolyte systems or under high-voltage fast-charging cell operation.
uncertainties: The final interphase-to-efficiency link is reported as an association, so the supplied evidence does not by itself establish that the LiF-rich interphase is the sole causal determinant of the measured efficiency.
Transferability beyond the reported electrolyte chemistry and matched test conditions is not established.
